newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN IPO - Vero President Systems Ltd.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN IPO - Vero President Systems Ltd.

text.p: The following initial public issue (IPO) by India's Vero President Systems Ltd is expected to be open for public subscription on September 28:
Face value Rs 10 Rs 22.50 per value

Vero President Systems is coming out with this public issue to finance modernisation and expansion of manufacturing facilities at Bangalore and to meet the costs of the issue. The company makes enclosures for electronic and telecommunication industry like cabinets, racks, card frames, plug modules and instrument cases.

Proceeds of the public issue will be used to complete the factory building in Bangalore and to buy new plant and machinery in order to broadbase its product range of enclosures. The total cost of the programme, technology fees, and margin money for working capital has been estimated at 73 million rupees and issue expenses at six million rupees.

Proposed financing is through 73.45 million rupees equity and 5.55 million rupees internal accruals. Out of the equity component, promoters bring in 32.50 million rupees and the balance 40.95 million rupees is to be collected from the public.

Out of the 79 million-rupee project cost, 23.96 million rupees is for buildings, 32.27 million for plant and machinery. 10.50 million rupees for know-how fees, 1.96 million rupees for contingencies, six million rupees for public issue expenses and 4.30 million rupees for working capital. The company says it has already spend 37.92 million rupees on the project.
Construction work is expected to be over by this November while commercial production is scheduled by December 1996. The company has not given any projections on the financial performance.

The company which started operations in 1982 as President Systems entered into a technical and financial collaboration in 1995 with Vero Group Plc of UK. As a result the company added the name Vero to its name and the foreign partner agreed to take up 35 percent of the equity in the company.
